dict.string: Women's Hologic WTA Tour live & daily match scores, PIF WTA Singles/Doubles Rankings, full-season tournament calendar, draws, and player 2026 Service/Return stats.
Scores · wtar rankings · wtas calendar · wtat draw · wtap player stats

## 🎾 WTA Tour — Alfred 5 Workflow
### Triggers (`wta`) | Type this | What you get | |-----------|-------------| | `wta` | Current WTA Tour match scores (Live → Today Upcoming/Final → Recent Main Draw, Singles default) | | `wta {filter}` | Filter scoreboard: `wta sabalenka`, `wta hong kong`, `wta live`, `wta doubles`, `wta qual`, `wta all` | | `wtar` | Official PIF WTA Singles Rankings (Top 50 default) | | `wtar {query}` | Filter rankings: `wtar doubles`, `wtar top10`, `wtar all` (Top 150), `wtar usa`, `wtar cze`, `wtar swiatek` | | `wtas` | Full-Season Hologic WTA Tour & Grand Slam Calendar (Active → Upcoming → Completed) | | `wtas {query}` | Filter calendar: `wtas slam`, `wtas 1000`, `wtas 500`, `wtas 250`, `wtas 125`, `wtas clay`, `wtas {city/month}` | | `wtat` / `wtat {query}` | Full Round-by-Round Tournament Draw (`Final` → `SF` → `QF` → `R16` → `R32`), `wtat doubles` | | `wtap {player}` | Unified Player Profile (Rank, YTD & Career W-L/Titles/Prize, `⌘` Serve Stats, `⌥` Return Stats) + Recent Matches |
